seen_animation: Frames 1-2: a hat drawn in black lines (dome, band line, brim with an upturned right end) is cut off by the upper-left edge of the frame; grey scenery shows a vertical line at left, a body/arm shape at lower left and a small polygon badge at upper right. Frames 2-4: the hat slides right and down into the frame and grows larger; a grey left hand appears under the brim and a grey right hand rises from the lower right toward the brim's right end. Frames 4-5: the hat's slanted left side line comes into view and the hat settles centre-left with both grey hands holding it. Frames 5-16: the hat and hands hold in place with only very small line differences.
seen_film: A white-domed police-style helmet with a black brim is brought from the upper-left into frame in front of a dark uniform with a badge at upper right. In frames 1-3 it is partly off the left edge and tilted; a hand reaches in from the lower right. By frames 4-5 both hands grip the brim and the helmet sits centre-left, level. Frames 5-16 hold that position with only slight hand and helmet drift.
named_subject: A helmet / hat with a dome, band line and brim, held in two hands
evidence: e.png frames 1-7 move the hat from the upper-left corner to its rest position in steady increments (g.png path 1 -> 4 -> 7 has no gaps or reversals), matching f.png frames 1-8 where the helmet enters from upper-left and settles by frame 8. The grey right hand enters at e.png frame 2 and reaches the brim by frame 5-6, as the film hand does in f.png 2-6. From e.png frame 8 to 32 the hat holds at the same place the film's helmet holds (f.png 8-32). Scale at rest is comparable: the animated brim spans roughly the same width as the film's brim. Judged from still frames only, not playback.
primary_gap: During the entrance (e.png frames 1-5) the hat stays level while the film's helmet is visibly tilted down to the right in f.png frames 2-5 and rotates level as it settles, so the arrival reads as a slide rather than the film's tilt-and-settle.
closes_when: In e.png frames 2-5 the band and brim lines slope down toward the right by a few degrees and rotate back to level by frame 7-8, matching the tilt in f.png 2-6.
protect: The doodle's construction from c.png (open dome stroke, separate band line, slanted left side line, brim with the upturned right end and the small tick at lower left), the continuous upper-left-to-centre entrance path, the entry timing that settles around frame 7-8, the rest position and scale, and the stable hold with no line boiling or redraws.
identity_gap: The hat is the c.png drawing with its same strokes and proportions; only the small extra tick lines at the brim's lower left are slightly doubled in frames 4-6 where they overlap the grey hand.
